title: 'You can laugh at solution': Sindhu reacts to monkey-proof Worlds preps
content: PV Sindhu praised organisers preparing Delhi’s BWF World Championships venue after animals disrupted the India Open earlier this year. The Indira Gandhi Stadium has been upgraded with sealed vents, double doors, anti-pest gel and predator-call machines. Three men trained to imitate langur calls have also been hired to deter monkeys. Sindhu called the efforts uniquely Indian and warmly welcoming.

title: Ethanol-blended diesel fails safety test, says govt; wider use ruled out for now
content: Ethanol-blended diesel fails safety specifications, lowering its flash point significantly.  Public sector oil companies tested these blends, finding them unsuitable for current use.  India is expanding ethanol use in petrol and exploring it for cooking fuel.  Oil marketing companies have already procured large volumes of ethanol for blending.  Further decisions on petrol blending will follow scientific and technical studies.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300m yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: In a surprising turn of events, Mark Zuckerberg's opulent yacht, Launchpad, faced backlash for not helping a stranded vessel within reach. Crew members clarified that they were on a different radio frequency and claimed assistance was imminent. A cruise ship later intervened, safely bringing the disabled boat back to Farragut Bay. Passengers on the cruise ship expressed their discontent by booing the yacht, which was positioned nearer to the emergency.

title: 7.4-magnitude quake kills 77 in Colombia; death toll 'could top 1,000'
content: A significant earthquake jolted western Colombia on Monday, resulting in injuries and extensive destruction. fourty seven fatalities have been confirmed while multiple buildings collapsed across the country. Air travel was halted at several airports in various cities. The quake's impact was felt as far as Bogota and neighboring nations, raising concerns about possible aftershocks. Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella is actively overseeing emergency response and recovery efforts.

title: 'Disrupts planning': Associate nations blast ICC over ODI World Cup format changes
content: The two European Associate Member boards said they were disappointed that the ICC had made what they described as “significant structural changes” less than 18 months before the tournament.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife MacKenzie Scott returns to writing with 80K-word novel
content: Novelist MacKenzie Scott returns to fiction writing after a thirteen-year hiatus. She will serially release an eighty-thousand-word novel throughout the month of August. Scott studied creative writing under Nobel laureate Toni Morrison at Princeton University. She has given away over twenty-six billion dollars to numerous charitable organizations. Her recent donation of twenty million dollars supports mental health initiatives.

title: Jharkhand protest: Devendra Mahto hospitalised; aide says injured in lathicharge
content: Several agitators and four policemen were injured during a clash near the Jharkhand assembly on Monday, as police used water cannons, tear gas and lathi-charged job aspirants protesting against the alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations, officials said. Pankaj Kumar, an aide of Mahto who was with him in the hospital, claimed that he was injured during lathi-charge by police near the assembly.

title: Google Drive ends Photos backups starting August 10: What users need to do
content: Starting August 10, 2026, the Google Drive desktop app will no longer support backups for Google Photos. Users are required to switch to the Google Photos app to continue folder backups smoothly. Thankfully, existing photos will remain intact and secure. However, to enable new automatic backups, users must adjust their settings, as this change affects only computer folder backups, leaving phone backups unaffected.

title: Tukaram Mundhe recalls friend's heartbreak over Madhuri Dixit's marriage during UPSC days
content: IAS officer and Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe recently recalled a humorous incident from his UPSC preparation days. During his Unstoppable Tukaram interaction in Pune, Mundhe remembered how his friend Pankaj, later a Customs Commissioner, suddenly broke down after learning that Bollywood star Madhuri Dixit had married Dr Shriram Nene in 1999.

title: DDA puts leasehold-to-freehold conversions on hold: What Delhi homeowners need to know
content: The ongoing review of the Delhi Development Authority's residential property conversion policy aims to streamline procedures for the public. All outstanding requests for conversion are currently frozen while this evaluation occurs. The policy allows for leasehold properties to transform into freehold, securing full ownership rights. This voluntary scheme encompasses a range of DDA-issued flats and plots.

title: George Russell and Carmen Montero Mundt’s combined net worth, careers and engagement
content: Engagement bells rang for Formula 1 star George Russell and finance guru Carmen Montero Mundt on August 9, 2026. Russell boasts a stunning net worth of $40 million, thanks to his illustrious racing career.  This year, Carmen Montero Mundt co-founded a skincare brand called Barriers. Their total financial portfolio now stands at an impressive $40.2 million, marking a significant milestone in their lives.

title: Tom Brady’s love advice: “The secret to being loved is to love” amid Gisele milestone
content: Tom Brady shared a heartfelt message about love on Instagram one day after news broke that ex-wife Gisele Bündchen had welcomed her first child with Joaquim Valente. The timing of the post sparked widespread discussion among fans, although Brady did not mention Bündchen directly. Reports later said he congratulated his former wife on the birth. The NFL legend continues to focus on co-parenting their children, family life and his post-football career.

title: Emma Gretzky engagement marks major family milestone for NHL icon Wayne Gretzky
content: Emma Gretzky, youngest daughter of NHL legend Wayne Gretzky, is engaged to former Southern Methodist University football player Stone Eby. The couple, who met at SMU and welcomed son Walter in 2025, shared the news of their engagement on Instagram. The news adds another personal milestone to the Gretzky family story, while bringing renewed attention to Wayne Gretzky’s family beyond his legendary hockey career.

title: ‘Broken overnight’: How stock market’s new closing auction is making traders jittery
content: New stock market closing system: Brokerages found themselves responding to a surge of client queries, while retail investors turned to social media after noticing that the official closing prices appeared to differ from where stocks had traded during the day.

title: BSE enters Nifty50, Wipro exits: What changes from September 30
content: BSE Ltd is set to take the place of Wipro Ltd in the prestigious Nifty 50 index from September 30, 2026. This alteration comes after a semi-annual review by NSE Indices, focusing on market capitalization metrics. Following this shift, Wipro will transition to the Nifty Next 50 index. BSE's inclusion is attributed to its notably greater free-float market capitalization, complemented by other index updates on the same date.

title: Rs 20cr revamp for Delhi World C'ships: Double-door entries and monkey whisperers
content: The Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi has undergone major upgrades and innovative measures to ensure a smooth BWF World Championships, returning to India after 17 years. Pigeons and monkeys, not the feathers of a shuttle, captured headlines during the India Open in January. After that chaos, organisers have installed double doors, noise machines, and bird-repellent gel, while a dedicated four-man team of monkey whisperers stands as the last line of defence.

title: Vijay's film producer Archana Kalpathi gets top post in TN govt committee
content: Film producer Archana Kalpathi Aghoram joins a state committee. This seven-member panel will appoint non-hereditary temple trustees for two years. Thavathiru Sivagnana Balaya Swamikal chairs the committee, and K Ramanathan serves as deputy. Archana is known for producing films with C Joseph Vijay. Her appointment follows Vijay naming a producer as a government representative.

title: 'Love & War' sparks Rs 300 crore distribution rights battle between major studios
content: Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s highly anticipated film 'Love & War' is drawing significant interest from distribution companies eager to secure its theatrical rights. With over Rs 200 crore already generated through non-theatrical ventures, the film's shooting is nearing completion. Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, this grand period drama is set to premiere in theaters on January 21, 2027.

title: 'IAS officer' posing as Ajit Doval's 'undercover agent' held, cops seize Tesla car
content: A man impersonating an IAS officer and claiming NSA links was arrested. Police found a Tesla car and imported liquor at his residence. He allegedly ran fraudulent operations across Bihar using fake credentials. Authorities are investigating his assets acquired through deception and corruption. The investigation also includes the possession of protected wildlife parts.

title: Beijing’s billion-barrel weapon: Why India must prepare for China-driven oil prices
content: China has accumulated as much as 1.4 billion barrels in strategic and enterprise-controlled inventories, according to a new RAND study. That is more than three times the roughly 413 million barrels held in the US government’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve.

title: Daughter saves father's 34-year-old shoe store with social media, draws long queues in London
content: A father's shoe shop faced closure due to rising rents and changing demographics. His daughter, Zineb, used TikTok to showcase vintage shoe styles to a new generation. This social media strategy attracted younger customers, revitalizing the family business significantly. The shop, once near closing, now sees long queues of eager buyers. Zineb's efforts have established an online presence and secured the business's future.

title: For India, the Mecca pact is a setback. For China, it's a warning
content: A new defense pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey has been signed. This agreement is seen as a setback for India's regional interests. China may benefit commercially from increased weapon system access. However, the pact could also reduce US military focus in West Asia. This shift might allow greater US attention on China's growing influence.

title: CINTAA rejects dissolution claims: Actors’ body says EC fully functional
content: CINTAA firmly denies accusations of its Executive Committee's dissolution, emphasizing that more than fifty percent resignations are necessary for such an outcome. The organization has addressed any vacancies according to its established constitutional protocols. Furthermore, CINTAA's legal representatives confirmed the committee is fully operational, ensuring the ongoing protection of artists' rights and welfare.

title: Trial by spin with a hint of reverse: Inside India's final net session in Colombo
content: In Colombo, Sarfaraz Khan stepped in as a replacement for Sai Sudharsan ahead of the two-match Test series against Sri Lanka. As the Indian team geared up for the series opener on August 15, the squad undertook a rigorous net practice, strategically adapting to the dry, cracked pitch conditions similar to those typically seen on Day 4. Captain Shubman Gill emphasised teamwork, collaborating intensely with throwdown specialists and coaches to fine-tune his batting ahead of the match.

title: Beyond fighter jets: India is building a new family of engines for missiles and drones
content: India has successfully developed a 350 kg class expendable turbojet engine for missiles.  The nation also demonstrated a 5 kN thrust class rotating detonation engine.  This engine technology promises faster and longer-range missile capabilities.  These advancements position India among select nations with advanced propulsion systems.  Future applications include drones and launch vehicle upper stages.

title: Indian-origin teenagers Bodhana, Shreyas become British chess champions
content: Indian-origin chess prodigies Bodhana Sivanandan, 11, and Shreyas Royal, 17, won the women’s and open titles at the 2026 British Chess Championships. Bodhana became the youngest British women’s champion, while Royal secured his first open title. Both have risen rapidly in chess, with Bodhana earning multiple honours and Royal becoming England’s youngest grandmaster at 15.

title: Brad Pitt's quote on love, loss and the risk of loving deeply
content: During promotional discussions for 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button', Brad Pitt explored the delicate interplay of love and loss, highlighting the risks entwined within these emotions. His journey began in Missouri, shaped by a strict upbringing and a passion for drama developed in school. Pitt’s ascent in Hollywood began with his breakout role in 'Thelma & Louise', leading to a career filled with blockbuster hits and financial success.

title: 'PM Modi or Amit Shah don't have guts': Rahul turns up heat amid Parliament showdown
content: Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi reiterated that the Union home minister Amit Shah must make a statement on police action against students protesting against NEET paper leak. The Congress leader said apart from Amit Shah's statement PM Modi should apologise for what happened and he called for an accountablity over the donation theft in Ayodhya Ram Mandir.  Rahul said opposition was not "interested in Amit Shah's fantasy conversations".

title: Woman’s lover hacks her husband 17 times with axe, injured in encounter
content: In a shocking crime of passion, a man named Talib was brutally attacked seventeen times with an axe by Aasim, the alleged lover of his wife. Following a tense shootout, police apprehended Aasim, who later confessed to the horrific act. Authorities have charged him and Talib's wife with murder and conspiracy, while the murder weapon has been secured as evidence.

title: Brazil footballer falls into tunnel while celebrating goal, suffers injury - Watch
content: Jacy, 29, was celebrating after heading Coritiba into a 2-0 lead against Chapecoense in the 41st minute of their Brazilian Serie A match. The defender picked up the ball and ran towards a group of supporters, jumping as he celebrated.

title: India diversifies energy sourcing; taps 15 countries for LNG, 41 for crude
content: India is expanding its energy import portfolio for both LNG and crude oil, striving to diminish reliance on any singular market or transport path. Additionally, the government is boosting domestic crude oil storage with new infrastructure. These strategies equip India to better handle supply interruptions and market fluctuations, ultimately strengthening the nation's resilience to global energy shocks.

title: Bengaluru 5 hotels raided, Mumbai eateries face action
content: Food safety regulations are having a moment in Maharashtra and Karnataka, with enforcement efforts stepping up significantly. Officials stumbled upon unlicensed vendors and alarming levels of unsanitary conditions, including rotten meat and expired dairy products. In Bengaluru, hotels are facing consequences for issues like poor labeling and inadequate food storage. Authorities are bolstering checks following numerous public complaints about food quality.

title: ONGC, Shell Energy India sign MoU to explore deepwater blocks, LNG sourcing opportunities
content: ONGC and Shell Energy India have entered into a memorandum of understanding to collaboratively delve into potential joint ventures. Their focus will be on assessing opportunities in deepwater and ultra-deepwater oil and gas exploration, alongside investigating LNG sourcing alternatives to bolster India's economic framework. This strategic partnership is designed to improve energy accessibility while ensuring long-term energy security for the nation.

title: 'Need conducive environment': Bangladesh PM on India ties as Hasina eyes return
content: The Prime Minister's Office said Rahman "emphasised the need to create a conducive environment to further advance the bilateral relations between the two countries". Dhaka also called on New Delhi to expedite Hasina's extradition, according to the statement Hasina has been living in India since the fall of her government. She faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh and was sentenced to death in November.

title: Kerala University removes banners and boards from campuses
content: Vice-Chancellor in-charge Mohanan Kunnummal had directed the organisations to remove the banners and boards within 24 hours a day ago

title: Bangladesh urges India to expedite Sheikh Hasina’s extradition
content: Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi calls on Prime Minister Tarique Rahman; “somewhat reassured” after meeting, says Bangladesh; exchanged views on “matters of mutual interest”, says India

title: K.M. Basheer hit-and-run case: witnesses give crucial testimony in court
content: Two friends of the accused, IAS officer Sriram Venkitaraman, Anish Raj and Athul Vijayakumar, were examined as the 10th and 11th witnesses at the Thiruvananthapuram Additional District and Sessions Court IV

title: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi, Congress of changing goalposts, disrupting House
content: The government has never shied away from taking up any issue, senior leader J.P. Nadda says; challenges the Leader of the Opposition to debate any issue in the Lok Sabha

title: 11 new entry points added for foreigners to enter India: Home Ministry
content: The Ministry says the newly notified entry points comprise airports at Bhopal and Tirupati, and land ports of Agartala, Darranga, Gede, Ghojadanga, Haridaspur, Jaigaon, Dawki, Moreh and Attari (Road)

title: Former Minister M.R.K. Panneerselvam sparks lively exchanges in Tamil Nadu Assembly
content: He says that in the past, he would relax only after 8 a.m. because his leader, Kalaignar  [M. Karunanidhi], would call him up early in the morning. “You [the Ministers] seem very relaxed,” he says. Minister for Water Resources N. Anand responds that Mr. Vijay will call him up and other Ministers even about repairing a vaikal (canal) and ask whether the work has been completed

title: Allahabad HC upholds religious conversion of two women, orders UP govt. and father to pay ₹25 lakh compensation
content: Hearing a habeas corpus petition, the court holds that the siblings aged 35 and 20 years were entitled to decide their faith, residence and personal affairs as adults

title: Not turbulence: Air India A320 suffered rare flight-control event before 300-foot altitude drop
content: Nine technical snags in a minute, including an autopilot disconnect, hydraulic failures and faults affecting the systems that control the aircraft’s nose-up and nose-down movement; Air India writes to Airbus

title: Protesting Maharashtra farmers demand ₹2 lakh incentive for regular loan repayment
content: Along with a waiver of up to ₹2 lakh, farmers, who paid EMI’s regularly were supposed to receive incentive of ₹50,000, which farmers believe is unfair

title: Ernakulam General Hospital plans mobile human milk collection unit
content: Unit to collect breast milk from donor lactating mothers outside the hospital; move aimed at strengthening human milk bank and bringing more mothers into donor network

title: Civil police officers to assist consumer dispute redressal commissions across Kerala
content: Civil police officers serving with magistrate, sessions courts to be deployed; Personnel to assist in executing summons, warrants and orders; move follows High Court concern over lack of police assistance for Commissions

title: UPI will remain free for consumers, Nirmala Sitharaman tells Rajya Sabha
content: Amid the Opposition walkout, Rajya Sabha passes the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill and returns the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill

title: Bharath offers ₹20 lakh aid to family of deceased medical student
content: Minister travels to Eklaspur village in Jogulamba Gadwal district of Telangana and pays floral tributes to Priyanka’s mortal remains

title: Land re-survey exercise will be completed by end of 2027, says A.P. CM
content: Strong security features, similar to those used for currency notes, have been incorporated into pattadar passbooks, says Naidu, addding that blockchain technology is being used to check tampering with land details

title: India donates five peacocks to UN office in Geneva
content: The five young peacocks comprise four blue peafowl and one white-feathered male, reflecting the blue and white colours associated with the United Nations

title: Kerala to implement comprehensive sea rescue system: Chief Minister Satheesan
content: Mechanism will ensure the safety of fishermen venturing into the sea, says CM; he gives assurance after visiting the residence of Gautam Krishnan, a 26-year-old fisher missing at sea since July 31

title: Jharkhand students protest LIVE: Mahto hospitalised as health deteriorates; police lathi-charge protesters again outside Assembly
content: Jharkhand BJP announces a State-wide bandh on August 10 to protest against police crackdown on student protesters

title: Supriya Sule’s meeting with PM sets off speculation over NCP(SP)’s stance on delimitation Bill
content: The party’s position on delimitation would be decided only after the government introduced a Bill in Parliament, NCP(SP) spokesperson Mahesh Tapase says in Mumbai

title: JLKM leader Devendra Nath Mahto hospitalised after 9-day hunger strike
content: JLKM leader Devendra Nath Mahto was hospitalised after his health deteriorated following a march by protesting students. Mahto has been on a hunger strike for nine days, alleging irregularities in Jharkhand recruitment examinations.

title: At least 10 people injured by pellets on July 20, shows RTI response
content: According to RTI responses by two hospitals to Trinamool Congress spokesperson Saket Gokhale, 10 people were brought in to hospital with pellet injuries during Jantar Mantar stir; hospital sources confirmed the authenticity of the response

title: Man kills two daughters, attempts to end life, but rescued at a luxury hotel in Bengaluru
content: The police recovered a note from the spot in which he allegedly referred to marital disputes with his wife and claimed that he suspected her of being in a relationship with another person.

title: Government offers Shah’s reply on students’ protests; Rahul says clarify who ordered ‘shooting of youngsters’
content: Government says Home Minister Amit Shah ready to reply to any discussion on student protests; Parliament deadlock continues as Opposition refused to relent

title: Activists question Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar’s participation in ‘pro-life’ rally
content: They contend that a constitutional office-holder taking part in such an event could set a wrong precedent on women’s reproductive autonomy

title: Congress alleges police brutality against student protesters in Bihar
content: Congress in-charge of Bihar Krishna Allavaru has claimed that police conducted midnight raids, arrested students and unleashed a “reign of terror” in an attempt to break their morale

title: Once a Maoist stronghold, Tummala now has schools and roads, says young Koya artiste
content: Patra Sowjanya, a Kommu Koya dance artiste from Tummala in Chintoor mandal, was about a year old when Maoists killed her father, Patra Mutyam, a postman and dancer, in 2014; she and her mother, Patra Jayamma, were in Vijayawada for World Adivasi Day

title: Number of ‘nil refills’ of LPG cylinders by PMUY beneficiaries per year in Karnataka sees a 107% increase between 2021 and 2026
content: The focus now must move from the number of connections distributed to sustained LPG usage and affordability among low-income households: MP

title: If harmful chemicals are found in cosmetics, we will ban them: U.T. Khader
content: A total of 22 cosmetic samples were collected by Drugs Inspectors and Assistant Drugs Inspectors from various places on Monday.

title: A.P. hit-and-run case: GSL Medical College pledges ₹20 lakh aid to Priyanka’s family
content: The GSL Medical College management has announced to operate four bus services for students to avoid any untoward incidents during the journey from Rajamahendravaram city to the college.

title: Vande Mataram to be sung from Red Fort for first time; Gen Z to get greater representation
content: Young students and members of Gen Z will get greater representation at the ceremony, with student achievers such as Olympiad medal winners to be seated on the ramparts of the Red Fort

title: Haryana CM downplays speculation over renewal of SAD-BJP alliance
content: ‘The BJP’s alliance is with the people of Punjab,’ says Nayab Singh Saini, adding, ‘There is no need to view anyone meeting with the Prime Minister through a political lens’

title: People very close to PM have stolen from Ram Temple: Rahul Gandhi
content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi alleged that people close to Prime Minister Narendra Modi have stolen money from the Ram Temple. Gandhi made the remarks while addressing allegations of financial irregularities linked to the construction of the Ram Temple.

title: A.P. Minister seeks people support in local bodies elections
content: Janardhan Reddy asks public not to trust the YSRCP, and says TDP-led coalition government is working for the welfare and development of the State

title: Watch: UPI payments will remain free: Nirmala Sitharaman
content: Parliament passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman clarifying that the legislation does not impose any tax or transaction charge on UPI payments. The Bill also seeks to attract foreign investment, promote domestic electronics manufacturing and ease operations for foreign cloud companies and fund managers in India.

title: YSRCP rally in Chandragiri seeks CBI probe against alleged DSC irregularities
content: Led by the YSRCP’s constituency in-charge Chevireddy Mohith Reddy, the party cadres took out a huge rally across Chandragiri; the 2-km long rally disrupted traffic for two hours on the road leading to Tirupati

title: Chief Minister Naidu to inaugurate 21.77-km Seed Access Road in Amaravati on August 13
content: The road, designated as E3, begins at Dondapadu and passes through Rayapudi, Venkatapalem, Penumaka, Undavalli, and Tadepalli before merging with NH-16 near Manipal Hospitals

title: Modernised Thalli Bidda express vehicles to be launched on August 11
content: New fleet to feature air-conditioning, six airbags, GPS tracking and other safety features to ensure safer transport for mothers and infants

title: 69 Killed After 7.4 Magnitude Earthquake Jolts Colombia, Situation "Critical"
content: According to the US Geological Survey, the earthquake struck at a depth of 107 kilometres. The earthquake was also felt in neighbouring Ecuador.

title: "Interesting Idea": After Iran's Demand, Trump Wants Compensation Of His Own
content: In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that he likes the "interesting idea" about Iran asking for compensation for the damage done to them during the last five months of war, and in return, he will also demand compensation from the Islamic Republic.

title: 'Didn't Want My Kids To Grow Up With Her': Bengaluru Man Kills 2 Daughters
content: 40-year-old SG Imran was found in a pool of blood in the toilet with his neck slit. The bodies of his daughters -- aged 10 and 5 -- were discovered just metres away.

title: Amid Employee Protests, Punjab Government Bets On 2 Bills To Shift Narrative
content: Employee unions have been among the most vocal critics of the Mann government, with repeated protests over regularisation, salaries and service conditions, as well as criticism over police action during some agitations.

title: Japan's Princess Akiko Visits Bhutan To Mark 40 Years of Ties, Meets King
content: Princess Akiko is visiting Bhutan to commemorate 40 years of diplomatic relations between Bhutan and Japan, at the invitation of King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck and Queen Jetsun Pema.

title: Jharkhand Students Protest Live Updates:  'Use Of Force Against Protesting Students Wrong,' Says Rahul Gandhi
content: Jharkhand Protest Live: The demonstration comes amid an ongoing agitation by students demanding the cancellation of controversial recruitment examinations conducted by the Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) and the Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC).

title: 11 Injured In Assam-Arunachal Border Clash Over Encroachment Dispute
content: The clash broke out following a dispute over alleged encroachment by Arunachal residents on land claimed to be within Assam territory.

title: BJP's Organisational Reset In Punjab Faces Another Challenge: Alliance Buzz
content: Punjab BJP president Kewal Singh Dhillon was summoned to Delhi. The Central leadership is learnt to have conveyed a clear message: Contain the rebellion, avoid arbitrary decisions and take everyone along.

title: After Rahul Gandhi's "Want Debate In Parliament" Demand, Kiren Rijiju's "Don't Run Away" Swipe
content: Dismissing the Opposition's demand for a statement from the prime minister as "theatrics", Kiren Rijiju told Rahul Gandhi to stand his ground in the Lok Sabha.

title: Sofa Factory Fire In Saudi Arabia Kills 16 Bangladeshi Migrant Workers
content: The foreign ministry reported "the tragic deaths of 16 Bangladeshi nationals in a fire at a sofa manufacturing factory in Riyadh" in its Monday statement.

title: From Maoist Stronghold To Tourism: New Vision For Infamous Karrigutta In Telangana
content: Telangana DGP C.V. Anand's visit to the once-inaccessible stronghold of Maoists showed how the region is now moving from a battlefield to a zone of roads, connectivity, tourism and development.

title: Disarm First Or Withdraw First? Debate That Could Sink Trump's Gaza Plan
content: The US president on July 30 hailed what he described as a breakthrough in talks to advance a 2025 ceasefire plan, saying that Hamas and other Gaza militants had accepted a 15-point roadmap by his so-called "Board of Peace" to give up their weapons.

title: Is Russia Plotting False Flag Op To Test NATO Resolve? Baltic States Think So
content: Lithuania said last week that Moscow is considering such a staged attack and Poland, Latvia and Estonia have also warned of acts of sabotage to test NATO's response at a time when US commitment to the Western military alliance is in question.

title: Who Is Mohsen Rezaei? 71-Year-Old War Hawk Running Iran's Security Council
content: Rezaei replaces Mohammad Baqer Zolqadr as second-in-command of the body that coordinates Iran's security and foreign policy and is chaired by President Masoud Pezeshkian. Zolqadr was appointed as political adviser to Khamenei.

title: Centre Notifies 11 New International Ports For Foreigners With E-Visas
content: The newly added land ports are Darranga, Gede, Ghojadanga, Haridaspur, Jaigaon, Dawki, Moreh, and Attari (Road), along with the airports in Bhopal and Tirupati.

title: '3 Flags, 1 Heart': Pak Anthem For Saudi-Turkey Defence Pact Sparks Ridicule
content: Days after the three countries signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, Pakistan's military media wing released a seven-minute music video celebrating what it presented as a powerful new alliance.

title: Class 11 Student Dies By Suicide After Father Takes Away Phone In Rajasthan
content: Following the death of his only son, Mayank's father, Chauthmal Nagar, who is a heart patient, also suffered a deterioration in his health.

title: Rajya Sabha Clears Taxation Bill, Government Rules Out UPI Charges
content: Replying to the discussion in the Rajya Sabha, Nirmala Sitharaman said the UPI-related amendment is only an enabling provision and does not itself impose any tax or transaction charge on users.

title: The war that keeps being born: Agent Orange and its multigeneration effects
content: some of us are lucky enough to catch a shooting star when we look up at the sky . some are unlucky enough to watch the decisions of old men in air-conditioned rooms send an airplane carrying a substance that would fall upon us and curse our entire bloodline to become a consequence of war .
